item.title: User Behavior Tracking System: Data Collection
item.description: User Behavior Tracking System: Data Collection From the previous blog, we have an overview of the user behavior tracking system, which consists of four main components: data collection, data processing, data storage, and data analysis. In this blog, we will dive into the details of the first component: data collection. Before we start, let’s briefly recall how to track user behavior from frontend UI interface. We can use javascript event listeners to capture user interactions such as mouse movements, clicks, scrolls, and keyboard inputs.
